units.characteristics: formation of the inner being (wisdom's aims)
units.gist: the stated aims of wisdom = what it builds in the inner being: knowing, understanding, prudence, discretion, receiving instruction

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD (as beginning/root)
units.gist: the motto - the fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge; a cornerstone inner posture (w/ Ps 111:10)

units.characteristics: filial receptivity; the self-destructive greedy heart
units.gist: the paternal appeal - receive instruction, and resist enticement; the ambushers who 'lie in wait for their own blood', greed that recoils on itself

units.characteristics: the refusal of wisdom; security of the one who listens
units.gist: Wisdom's cry - loving simplicity, delighting in scoffing, hating knowledge, ignoring counsel, and its fatal end vs 'whoever listens will dwell secure, without dread'

units.characteristics: the seeking of wisdom; reception that reshapes the heart
units.gist: if you make the ear attentive and incline the heart, seek it like silver - then you understand the fear of the LORD; wisdom comes INTO the heart, pleasant to the soul

units.characteristics: discretion guarding the self; deliverance from evil
units.gist: understanding/discretion watch over the self, delivering from perverse men and the forbidden woman; the two ways close it (upright inhabit the land)

units.characteristics: receptivity; the heart as the tablet
units.gist: do not forget my teaching, let your heart keep it; bind steadfast love and faithfulness on the heart-tablet

units.characteristics: trust in the LORD; not leaning on one's own understanding; fear
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'trust in the LORD with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding... fear the LORD' (whole-hearted trust vs self-reliance, w/ the Psalter trust cluster)

units.characteristics: honoring God; receiving discipline as a father's love
units.gist: honor the LORD with wealth; do not despise his discipline, for he reproves whom he loves - correction received as love

units.characteristics: prizing/desiring wisdom above all goods
units.gist: wisdom more precious than jewels, nothing you desire compares; a tree of life - the valuing/desire of wisdom

units.characteristics: the fearless security/rest of the wise
units.gist: keep sound wisdom - walk securely, foot not stumble, lie down without fear, sweet sleep, no dread of sudden terror (the LORD your confidence)

units.characteristics: the disposition toward the neighbour
units.gist: withhold not good, plot not evil against the trusting neighbour, contend not without cause, envy not the violent - the outward-facing heart

units.characteristics: the inherited pursuit/prizing of wisdom
units.gist: the father's own inherited charge - 'get wisdom... prize her highly, and she will exalt you'; wisdom loved and embraced across generations

units.characteristics: the two paths; the compulsive evil that cannot rest
units.gist: the path of the righteous (dawn brightening) vs the way of the wicked who 'cannot sleep unless they have done wrong' - evil as an inner compulsion

units.characteristics: guarding the heart as the source of life
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'keep your heart with all vigilance, for from it flow the springs of life'; then the gates guarded (speech, eyes, feet)

units.characteristics: discernment of deceptive allure
units.gist: the forbidden woman's lips drip honey but end bitter as wormwood - the self learning to read sweet surfaces that end in death

units.characteristics: the retrospective regret of the self that despised reproof
units.gist: the ruin of yielding, voiced from the end - 'how I hated discipline, my heart despised reproof... I did not listen'; regret as the wage of un-teachability

units.characteristics: rightly ordered desire/delight
units.gist: rejoice in the wife of your youth, be intoxicated in her love - desire not killed but rightly directed

units.characteristics: the self ensnared by its own sin
units.gist: the LORD ponders all paths; the wicked is held fast in the cords of his own sin - iniquity as self-binding

units.characteristics: sloth as an inner disposition
units.gist: go to the ant, O sluggard; the 'little sleep, little slumber' that lets poverty in - the self's drift into ruin through inaction

units.characteristics: the malicious heart legible in gesture and speech
units.gist: the worthless person - crooked speech, winking eyes, 'with perverted heart devises evil, continually sowing discord'; malice read off the body

units.characteristics: catalogue of inner-being evils God hates
units.gist: the seven abominations - haughty eyes, lying tongue, a heart that devises wicked plans, feet swift to evil, false witness, discord-sower

units.characteristics: desire guarded; adultery as self-destruction
units.gist: the commandment a lamp; 'do not desire her beauty in your heart'; he who commits adultery 'destroys himself'; jealousy's fury

units.characteristics: receptivity; intimacy with wisdom
units.gist: keep my commandments as the apple of your eye; call wisdom 'sister', insight your intimate friend - wisdom held as a beloved kin

units.characteristics: the anatomy of a naive heart yielding
units.gist: the young man 'lacking sense' seduced step by step; 'he does not know that it will cost him his life' - the naive self undone by seductive speech

units.characteristics: guarding the heart against turning aside
units.gist: 'let not your heart turn aside to her ways' - the heart's self-guarding against the well-trodden path to death

units.characteristics: wisdom's public self-commendation; its value
units.gist: Wisdom calls at the crossroads - truth from her lips, better than silver/jewels; nothing you desire compares

units.characteristics: the mutual love of the self and wisdom; fear = hatred of evil
units.gist: 'the fear of the LORD is hatred of evil'; 'I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find me' - love and seeking rewarded with finding

units.characteristics: the blessedness of watching/waiting for wisdom; life vs death
units.gist: 'blessed is the one who listens... watching daily at my gates, waiting beside my doors'; 'whoever finds me finds life... all who hate me love death'

units.characteristics: the invitation to leave simplicity and live
units.gist: Wisdom's feast - 'leave your simple ways, and live, and walk in the way of insight'; the summoned turn from folly

units.characteristics: teachability - the response to reproof reveals the heart
units.gist: GEM - 'reprove a scoffer and he will hate you; reprove a wise man and he will love you'; the wise grow wiser by correction - the teachable vs unteachable heart

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD (as beginning/root)
units.gist: the motto restated - 'the fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom' (cornerstone, w/ 1:7, Ps 111:10)

units.characteristics: the counterfeit allure of folly
units.gist: Folly personified - 'stolen water is sweet, bread eaten in secret is pleasant'; the pleasant lie whose guests are in Sheol (the mirror-image of wisdom's feast)
